method: Inspected complete white-background librsvg raster and four native-coordinate crops. Read associated SVG/table attributes independently. No browser interaction tested.
observations: All 41 display nodes and 46 arrow relationships are present; seven construct instances and two molecular-state instances are visibly marked.
The two ascorbate recovery arrows point to distinct molecular-state objects; peroxide/ferricyanide inhibition arrows point to the native base complex.
Ascorbate retains the chemical entity label; no invented stereochemical subtype is displayed.
No node overlap, clipped node text, dangling endpoint or absent evidence-table anchor was observed.
Long edge lanes require full-size scrolling/zoom; fit-width view is dense.
Long construct/state labels are intentionally abbreviated visually; full qualifier descriptions/evidence remain accessible in SVG details and correct edge endpoint table cells.
